## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle Yuán-period composite work combines [師正](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%AD%A3) Shīzhèng's sectional outline with [圓澄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%9C%93%E6%BE%84) Yuánchéng's *huì shū* commentary on *Niè pán jīng huì shū* 涅槃經會疏 ([KR6g0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0016)). The "圓澄" here is most likely the late-Míng / Qīng Yúnmén-school Chán master *Hānshān Yuánchéng* 雲門圓澄 (1561–1626) or his Japanese namesake; the precise identification is uncertain.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1280–1368) reflects the Yuán dynasty period.
